overview: When someone fills in your contact, order or booking form, the details should land where you work, not sit in an inbox. We connect your form to a sheet, CRM or database, map each answer to the right column, tidy formats and add a notification for your team. Files uploaded through the form are saved to a folder and linked in the same row.

faq: Which form tools do you connect?
Google Forms, Typeform, Jotform, Tally, Wix forms, WordPress form plugins and many others. If your form can send data when submitted, we can usually receive it.
Which places can the data go?
Google Sheets, Excel online, Airtable, Notion, HubSpot, Zoho and many databases. We confirm that your destination has a connection we can use before you order.
What if someone submits the form twice?
The Premium package checks for matching entries and flags or skips repeats, depending on your rule. Without that check, each submission is added as its own row.
Can I change the fields later?
Yes. Adding a field is small work, and our handover notes explain how. For bigger changes, you can order a small follow-up job.
